#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| FTShare 或匿名数据源 | 请求新行情时 | 获取数据 | 不假定覆盖和时效 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | Python 环境和依赖 | 核版本和固定数据 | 首次时延未知 |
| 持续 | 行情、模型和本地计算 | 核对来源、延迟和 revision | 真实费用未知 |
| 失败与退出 | 状态日志和测试目录 | 先判断应用状态再重试 | 关闭与残留未测 |

[Q01](#research-q01) 的工具调用关联、[Q02](#research-q02) 的准备和应用边界，以及 [Q03](#research-q03) 的结果未知状态分别针对界面、写入和进程问题。
[Q01](#research-q01) 将成功工具结果与对应会话的原生图表标签连起来。[Q02](#research-q02) 把历史候选和修改申请拆开，并核对版本和来源快照。
[Q02](#research-q02) 的形态取决于已加载日线和收盘判断，queued 还要等待真实应用。[Q03](#research-q03) 的工具目录能先于后端就绪，断线前派发的操作也可能结果未知。
[Q04](#research-q04) 提出并列显示工具调用来源、规则截止和图表版本，验证是否减少误用旧图和人工核对。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 用已关联工具事件把外部图表带入宿主，[Q02](#research-q02) 加版本和准备记录防止应用到错误视图。可复用在具备会话事件与稳定视图身份的宿主，规则绘图和数据质量仍分离。

business.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 相比独立图表可减少手工定位，并形成对应会话的可核对标注；依赖 DSH 和行情覆盖，未见实际成本收益。

recommendation.reason: 需要在 DSH 复盘历史走势的用户，可以用可丢弃 profile 和固定日线样本核对一张图的标注。相比在独立图表与对话间手工复制标的和日期，工具结果能交接到同一会话的图表。若来源、视图版本或应用状态无法核对，就回到独立图表与原记录。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 src/client/conversation.ts 48–99 与 [Q04](#research-q04) 的对照对应反复从模型结果回图的摩擦，超过一般用途，真实频度尚未验证。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的会话交接与 [Q02](#research-q02) 的 tools/chart_applications.py 150–203 将定位和修改边界组合，超过局部入口；历史固定数据可收窄反例，宿主实际表现未到充分。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 追事件到交接，[Q02](#research-q02) 追数据与实际申请，[Q03](#research-q03) 追后端失败及密钥，比入口核查更全；未运行真实宿主或测试。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 的启动准备和 [Q04](#research-q04) 的独立图表退路让试用可控，高于恢复无途径的档，仍需核对数据和运行状态。

## 支持哪些绘图

对话和图表面板使用同一套绘图能力。自动绘图以**当前已加载的最近已收盘日线**为准，默认显示最新合格候选；也可以指定候选、日期和点位。

| 绘图工具 | 自动绘图 | 手动选点与自然语言操作 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **水平线** | 查找近期高点／低点作为价位候选 | 指定价格，或点选 K 线；可作为支撑、压力或自定义价位 |
| **趋势线** | 查找近期符合条件的两点走势 | 指定两个时间与价位，创建或调整线段 |
| **平行通道** | 查找近期通道候选 | 选择三个锚点，调整边界及中线样式 |
| **平台框／箱体** | 查找符合边界接触与漂移条件的近期区间 | 框定时间和上下边界，调整名称、颜色及填充 |
| **斐波那契回撤** | 从近期波段寻找锚点 | 指定波段起终点及回撤比例，整组修改或删除 |
| **ABC 波段／ABC 浪标注** | 查找符合几何条件的 0／A／B／C 波段候选 | 自选锚点，或让宿主核对后落图；可单独修改指定点 |
| **双顶** | 识别顶部结构及后续状态 | 手动指定结构锚点，仍需满足识别规则 |
| **双底** | 识别底部结构及后续状态 | 手动指定结构锚点，仍需满足识别规则 |
| **头肩顶** | 识别双肩、头部与颈线 | 手动指定五个结构锚点，并校验形态 |
| **头肩底** | 识别反向头肩结构与颈线 | 手动指定五个结构锚点，并校验形态 |
| **平台突破／失效** | 冻结平台边界，标示待确认、突破确认及失效状态 | 自选区间使用普通平台框；状态由行情分析得出 |
| **九转计数** | 逐根显示上涨／下跌 1–9；行情变化后更新 | 由行情自动计数，可调整显示范围与样式 |

**ABC 是波段几何候选与折线标注，不等于完整艾略特波浪识别。** 价格形态与九转当前支持 A／港／美股已收盘日线；找不到合格候选时会说明原因，不强行绘制。

### 指标与更多标注

- **指标面板：** SMA、EMA、VOL、MACD、KDJ、RSI、BOLL、ATR、VWAP。SMA／EMA／BOLL 也支持由宿主计算并添加为独立指标对象。
- **自然语言标注：** 文字、数值、箭头与菱形图标、带标签折线；支持按名称或指定点继续修改。
- **进阶工具接口：** 条件价格序列、价带与条件柱线。具体输入、显示范围及限制见[函数与绘图说明](docs/chart-functions.md)。
- **图形管理：** 创建、改名、改色、更新锚点、删除；同一张图可叠加多个对象。201 个 TA-Lib 函数可查询计算，只有已接入的图形与指标支持落图。

## 自然语言绘图实测

### ABC 候选：核对锚点后画到图上

DeepSeek 核对卧龙电驱日 K 的 0／A／B／C 四个锚点，再通过插件绘制。完整截图同时保留了左侧对话与右侧实际图形。

[![自然语言绘制卧龙电驱 ABC：对话核对四个锚点，日 K 图显示 0、A、B、C 折线和标签](docs/images/natural-language-abc-wolong-2026-10-27.png)](docs/images/natural-language-abc-wolong-2026-10-27.png)

### 在同一张图上继续添加下降通道

继续提出绘图请求，宿主核对通道锚点后添加平行边界，原有 ABC 标注保留。

[![自然语言追加下降通道：日 K 主图同时保留 ABC 标注与通道边界](docs/images/natural-language-descending-channel-wolong-2026-10-27.png)](docs/images/natural-language-descending-channel-wolong-2026-10-27.png)

以上两张为 2026-10-27 的完整实测截图，保留当时的对话和界面。点击图片可查看原图；当前绘图操作见下文。

可以这样提出需求：

```text
打开卧龙电驱日 K，核对最近一个 ABC 波段候选，符合条件就画出来。
在同一张图上添加下降通道，保留已有 ABC 标注。
找最近一个符合规则的双底并画出来，说明现在处于什么状态。
显示最近 30 根已收盘日线的九转计数。
把“关键支撑”改成蓝色，并移到 30.8 元。
```

请求“分析”时返回分析；明确请求“画出来”时直接绘制。用户指定点位或候选时，优先使用其选择。

## 绘图工作台与价格形态

点击 **绘图** → 选择工具 → **绘图**。需要自行指定锚点时使用 **手动选点**，通过 **设置** 调整参数；图形直接展示，无需另行保存。关闭或收起面板不会删除图形，**清除** 位于绘图面板内。

### 箱体形成、突破与失效状态

微软日 K 实例：08/28—09/25 形成平台，10/06 确认上破。图上展示箱体边界与实际确认日期；后续行情不会扩大已经冻结的箱体。

[![微软日 K 的平台箱体与上破确认日](docs/images/platform-breakout-msft-v0.6.9.png)](docs/images/platform-breakout-msft-v0.6.9.png)

双顶／底、头肩顶／底同样显示颈线及候选、确认、失效等状态。九转显示逐根计数，基础九转不包含完整 DeMARK 13 Countdown。定义与适用范围见[形态规则](docs/price-pattern-rules-v1.md)。

## 大盘与主图对比

### 把对比折线放进 K 线主图

搜索添加个股、指数或 ETF，将其走势作为背景折线叠加在主图中。主标的继续显示蜡烛图与指标，对比线可以分别隐藏或移除。

[![上证指数主图叠加沪深300、创业板指对比折线](docs/images/main-chart-comparison-v0.6.9.png)](docs/images/main-chart-comparison-v0.6.9.png)

*对比线按共同基准归一化，比较累计涨跌幅；不直接比较不同标的的绝对价格，也不为对比线计算技术指标。*

### 大盘概览

浏览 A／港／美主要指数、板块排行和龙虎榜，点击标的进入图表，继续查看行情与资料。

[![大盘概览：主要指数、板块排行与龙虎榜](docs/images/market-overview-v0.6.9.png)](docs/images/market-overview-v0.6.9.png)

大盘、主图对比与微软平台三张新图保留原生 Retina 像素，以无损 PNG 展示。行情是截图时的快照。

## 安装

支持 macOS、Linux 和原生 Windows。首次启动需要联网准备依赖，可能耗时数分钟。

### DeepSeek Harness

先安装可用的 DSH Web 和 **Python 3.11+**，然后执行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @ftshare-lab/dsh-kline@0.6.10
```

也可使用 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:FTShare-Lab/dsh_kline
```

插件市场中搜索 `dsh_kline` 也可安装；市场的版本与下载数据随其目录同步。npm 当前版本见[包页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ftshare-lab/dsh-kline)，下载量不代表独立安装人数。

[![插件市场中的 dsh_kline 安装与更新入口](docs/images/dsh-market.png)](docs/images/dsh-market.png)

启用后点击右侧 **K**，或直接在对话中请求分析。新版 DSH 自带原生右侧标签，无需安装 Better Sidebar；在 **UI → 工作台标签** 中切换，经典 K 侧栏仍可使用。v0.6.10 已验证 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的原生自动开图；该宿主属于预发布版本。

### Codex

先安装支持插件的 Codex、Git、**Node.js 22.19+** 和 **Python 3.11+**：

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add FTShare-Lab/dsh_kline --ref main
codex plugin add ft-kline@ftshare
```

重新打开 Codex，请求「打开招商银行日 K」。FTShare 是本项目维护的公开 GitHub 插件源。

## 数据与适用范围

- **行情来源：** 可接入 FTShare；在「设置 → 数据源」配置并测试 Key。无 Key 时可尝试部分 A 股、港美股历史日 K 和指数备用行情，覆盖与可用性取决于公开源。
- **权限与周期：** 分钟线、新闻和公司资料取决于来源与权限。自动绘图、价格形态与九转当前使用已加载的 A／港／美股已收盘日线。
- **修改边界：** 绘图使用当前图真实 K 线。数据来源不明、结果过期或活动视图存在歧义时，会停止修改并说明原因；鼠标拖拽改点与撤销暂不支持。
- **保存范围：** DSH 自选与分组跨对话保留。Codex 图表、自选及应用内临时 Key 保存在当前连接内存中，不继承 DSH 配置；绘图不保证跨服务重启恢复。

行情可能延迟。形态与计数用于研究和复盘，不保证交易收益。数据覆盖见[无 Key 支持范围](docs/anonymous-market-support.md)与[港美股免费日线](docs/free-foreign-daily.md)。

async function writeStamp(venvDirectory, fingerprint) {
  const destination = join(venvDirectory, REQUIREMENTS_STAMP)
  const temporary = `${destination}.${process.pid}.tmp`
  await writeFile(temporary, `${fingerprint}\n`, { encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o600 })
  try {
    await replaceWithRetry(temporary, destination)
  } finally {
    await rm(temporary, { force: true })
  }

async function venvInterpreterMatches(venvDirectory, runtimePython) {
  const runtimeVersion = commandOutput(runtimePython, [], RUNTIME_VERSION_CHECK)
  if (!/^\d+\.\d+$/.test(runtimeVersion)) return false
  try {
    const config = await readFile(join(venvDirectory, 'pyvenv.cfg'), 'utf8')
    const match = config.match(/^\s*version\s*=\s*(\d+\.\d+)(?:\.\d+)?\s*$/mi)
    return match?.[1] === runtimeVersion
  } catch {

  }

async function replaceWithRetry(source, destination) {
  const attempts = process.platform === 'win32' ? 6 : 1
  let lastError
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < attempts; attempt += 1) {
    try {
      await rename(source, destination)
      return
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error
      if (process.platform !== 'win32' || !['EACCES', 'EPERM', 'EEXIST'].includes(error?.code) || attempt + 1 === attempts) break
      await rm(destination, { force: true }).catch(() => {})
      await new Promise(resolveDelay => setTimeout(resolveDelay, 40 * (attempt + 1)))
    }
  }
  throw lastError
}

export function backgroundBootstrapSpawnOptions(platform = process.platform, env = process.env) {
  return {
    cwd: PROJECT_ROOT,
    env,
    // The bootstrap must outlive the short-lived MCP handshake process on
    // every host. On Windows, `unref()` alone does not detach a child from
    // the parent's process group/job, so the child can be reaped as soon as
    // the initial MCP attempt exits.
    detached: true,
    stdio: 'ignore',

async function findBootstrapPython(venvDirectory, logPath, preferred = '') {
  const candidates = await bootstrapCandidates(venvDirectory, preferred)
  const seen = new Set()
  const outcomes = new Set()
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const key = `${candidate.command}\u0000${candidate.args.join('\u0000')}`
    if (seen.has(key)) continue
    seen.add(key)
    const result = spawnSync(candidate.command, [...candidate.args, '-c', RUNTIME_VERSION_CHECK], {
      env: pythonEnvironment(), encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 10_000, maxBuffer: 64 * 1024, windowsHide: true,
    })
    const outcome = pythonProbeOutcome(candidate, result, process.platform, await resolvedPythonCommand(candidate))
    if (outcome.code === 'PYTHON_READY' && !commandPasses(candidate.command, candidate.args, 'import venv, ensurepip')) {
      outcome.code = 'PYTHON_VENV_UNAVAILABLE'
    }
    // Record only paths, versions and classifications; never dump the parent
    // environment or arbitrary output from a failed executable.
    const diagnostic = `[dsh_kline] Python candidate: ${JSON.stringify({ command: candidate.command, args: candidate.args, ...outcome })}\n`
    await appendFile(logPath, diagnostic, 'utf8')
    process.stderr.write(diagnostic)
    if (outcome.code === 'PYTHON_READY') return candidate
    outcomes.add(outcome.code)
  }
  const hint = process.platform === 'win32'
    ? 'Install Python 3.11 or newer from python.org, enable the Python Launcher, or set DSH_KLINE_PYTHON.'
    : 'Install Python 3.11 or newer, or set DSH_KLINE_PYTHON to its executable.'
  const code = ['PYTHON_VENV_UNAVAILABLE', 'PYTHON_VERSION_TOO_OLD', 'PYTHON_STORE_ALIAS', 'PYTHON_EXECUTION_FAILED']
    .find(code => outcomes.has(code)) || 'PYTHON_NOT_FOUND'
  const message = {
    PYTHON_VENV_UNAVAILABLE: 'Python was found but cannot create a virtual environment (venv/ensurepip missing).',
    PYTHON_VERSION_TOO_OLD: 'Python was found but its version is below Python 3.11.',
    PYTHON_STORE_ALIAS: 'Detected a Windows Store Python placeholder, not a usable interpreter. Install python.org Python or set DSH_KLINE_PYTHON to the full python.exe file path.',
    PYTHON_EXECUTION_FAILED: 'A Python candidate could not execute or report its version.',
    PYTHON_NOT_FOUND: 'No usable Python interpreter was found; dsh_kline requires Python 3.11 or newer.',
  }[code]
  throw runtimeError(code, `${message} ${hint}`)
}

async function runLogged(command, args, logPath) {
  const startedAt = Date.now()
  await mkdir(dirname(logPath), { recursive: true })
  const log = createWriteStream(logPath, { flags: 'a', mode: 0o600 })
  return await new Promise((resolveRun, rejectRun) => {
    let settled = false
    const child = spawn(command, args, {
      cwd: PROJECT_ROOT,
      env: pythonEnvironment(),
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      windowsHide: true,
    })
    const forward = chunk => {
      process.stderr.write(chunk)
      log.write(chunk)
    }
    child.stdout.on('data', forward)
    child.stderr.on('data', forward)
    child.once('error', error => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      log.end()
      rejectRun(error)
    })
    child.once('close', code => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      log.end()
      if (code === 0) resolveRun(Date.now() - startedAt)
      else rejectRun(new Error(`${command} exited with code ${code}`))
    })
  })
}

async function prepareRuntime(venvDirectory, fingerprint, logPath, preferredPython = '', clearExisting = false) {
  await mkdir(dirname(venvDirectory), { recursive: true })
  await mkdir(dirname(logPath), { recursive: true })
  await writeFile(logPath, '', { encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o600 })
  const runtimePython = pythonPathForVenv(venvDirectory)
  const reusable = !clearExisting && await pathExists(runtimePython)
    && commandPasses(runtimePython, [], VERSION_CHECK) && await venvInterpreterMatches(venvDirectory, runtimePython)
    && (commandPasses(runtimePython, [], 'import pip') || commandPasses(runtimePython, [], 'import ensurepip'))
  if (reusable) {
    process.stderr.write('[dsh_kline] Reusing the existing Python environment.\n')
    if (!commandPasses(runtimePython, [], 'import pip')) await bootstrapStep('PYTHON_VENV_UNAVAILABLE',
      'Cannot prepare pip in the existing environment', runtimePython, ['-m', 'ensurepip', '--upgrade'], logPath)
  } else {
    const base = await findBootstrapPython(venvDirectory, logPath, preferredPython)
    process.stderr.write('[dsh_kline] Creating or repairing the Python environment…\n')
    // Python -m venv does not replace an existing interpreter when upgrading
    // across Python versions. Clear any unusable venv before creating it again.
    const replaceExisting = clearExisting || await pathExists(runtimePython)
    const venvArgs = [...base.args, '-m', 'venv', ...(replaceExisting ? ['--clear'] : []), venvDirectory]
    const venvMs = await bootstrapStep('PYTHON_VENV_UNAVAILABLE', 'Cannot create or repair the virtual environment', base.command, venvArgs, logPath)
    process.stderr.write(`[dsh_kline] Python environment ready in ${Math.ceil(venvMs / 1000)}s.\n`)
  }
  process.stderr.write('[dsh_kline] Installing dependencies…\n')
  // Isolate pip from a user's config (notably `user = true`, which makes a
  // venv install fail before it can write the ready stamp).
  const dependenciesMs = await bootstrapStep('PYTHON_DEPENDENCY_INSTALL_FAILED', 'Dependency installation failed',
    runtimePython, ['-m', 'pip', '--isolated', 'install', '-r', REQUIREMENTS_FILE], logPath)
  process.stderr.write(`[dsh_kline] Dependencies ready in ${Math.ceil(dependenciesMs / 1000)}s.\n`)
  process.stderr.write('[dsh_kline] Verifying the runtime…\n')
  await bootstrapStep('PYTHON_IMPORT_CHECK_FAILED', 'Installed dependency verification failed',
    runtimePython, ['-c', await dependencyImportCheck()], logPath)
  await writeStamp(venvDirectory, fingerprint)
  await rm(join(venvDirectory, BOOTSTRAP_FAILURE), { force: true })
  if (!(await stampMatches(venvDirectory, fingerprint))) {
    throw new Error('Dependency fingerprint was not persisted; refusing to report a ready runtime.')
  }
  process.stderr.write('[dsh_kline] Dependency fingerprint saved.\n')
  return runtimePython
}

async function readBootstrapFailure(venvDirectory, fingerprint, environment) {

async function writeBootstrapFailure(venvDirectory, fingerprint, error) {

function bootstrapFailureRetryAt(failure) {

function processIsAlive(pid) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid <= 0) return false
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0)
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    return error?.code === 'EPERM'
  }

async function readBootstrapMarker(marker) {
  try {
    const details = JSON.parse(await readFile(marker, 'utf8'))
    return details && typeof details === 'object' ? details : null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

async function writeBootstrapMarker(marker, details) {

  await writeFile(temporary, JSON.stringify(details), { encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o600 })
  try {

  }

  await rm(marker, { force: true }).catch(() => {})

async function bootstrapIsRunning(venvDirectory) {
  const marker = join(venvDirectory, BOOTSTRAP_RUNNING)

async function startBackgroundBootstrap(venvDirectory) {
  if (await bootstrapIsRunning(venvDirectory)) return false
  await mkdir(venvDirectory, { recursive: true })
  const marker = join(venvDirectory, BOOTSTRAP_RUNNING)
  const startedAt = new Date().toISOString()
  try {
    // Reserve the marker before spawning so concurrent reconnect attempts do
    // not launch duplicate dependency installers.
    await writeFile(marker, JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, started_at: startedAt }), {
      encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx',
    })
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.code === 'EEXIST') return false
    throw error
  }

    child = spawn(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), '--bootstrap-runtime'], backgroundBootstrapSpawnOptions())
    child.once('error', () => { void clearBootstrapMarker(venvDirectory, child?.pid || process.pid) })
    child.once('exit', () => { void clearBootstrapMarker(venvDirectory, child?.pid || process.pid) })

    throw error
  }

async function launchServer(runtimePython, runtimeDirectory) {
  await mkdir(runtimeDirectory, { recursive: true })
  const serverEntry = String(process.env.FT_KLINE_SERVER_ENTRY || '').trim() || 'server.py'
  if (!['server.py', 'codex_server.py'].includes(serverEntry)) throw new Error('FT_KLINE_SERVER_ENTRY must be server.py or codex_server.py')
  const child = spawn(runtimePython, [join(PROJECT_ROOT, serverEntry)], {
    cwd: PROJECT_ROOT,
    env: pythonEnvironment({

      ...(serverEntry === 'server.py' ? settingsCredentialEnvironment(runtimeDirectory) : {}),
    }),
    stdio: 'inherit',
    windowsHide: true,
  })
  const forwardSignal = () => {
    if (child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) child.kill()
  }
  process.once('SIGINT', forwardSignal)
  process.once('SIGTERM', forwardSignal)
  const result = await new Promise((resolveExit, rejectExit) => {
    child.once('error', rejectExit)

  })
  process.removeListener('SIGINT', forwardSignal)
  process.removeListener('SIGTERM', forwardSignal)

/** Resolve one active conversation across the two public DSH session shapes. */
export function currentConversationId(snapshot: SessionListSnapshot): string | undefined {
  if (typeof snapshot.current === 'string' && snapshot.current.length > 0) return snapshot.current
  const active = Object.entries(snapshot.byId ?? {})

// Harness 0.1.2 moved rendered nodes out of SessionSnapshot. Consume the
// owning session's public event window, independent of Chat/Trajectory UI.
// Match results to invocation starts so a slow old call cannot steal the chart.
export function latestChartFromEvents(entries: SessionEventWindow['entries']): ChartReference | undefined {
  const calls = new Map<string, { name: string; time: number }>()
  const nodes: any[] = []
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.type !== 'event') continue
    const event = entry.event
    const data = event?.data
    if (event?.type === 'tool/call' && typeof data?.callId === 'string') {
      calls.set(data.callId, { name: data.name, time: event.time })
    } else if (event?.type === 'tool/code-dispatch-start' && typeof data?.subCallId === 'string') {
      calls.set(data.subCallId, { name: data.name, time: event.time })
    }

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.type !== 'event') continue
    const event = entry.event
    const data = event?.data
    if (event?.type === 'tool/result') {
      const message = data?.message
      // DSH 0.2 emits one first-class tool-role message per invocation. The
      // 0.1 adapter below still handles nested tool-result content blocks.
      // In both cases the invocation start supplies the trusted tool name and
      // ordering; result text alone must never claim a chart.
      if (message?.role === 'tool' && typeof message.toolCallId === 'string') {
        const call = calls.get(message.toolCallId)
        if (call) nodes.push({ kind: 'tool-result', call, callTime: call.time,
          content: message.content, isError: message.isError || !!data.error })
        continue
      }
      for (const block of data?.message?.content ?? []) {
        if (block?.type !== 'tool-result') continue
        const call = calls.get(block.toolCallId)
        if (!call) continue // Never guess a truncated call's identity.
        nodes.push({ kind: 'tool-result', call, callTime: call.time, content: block.content, isError: block.isError || !!data.error })
      }
    } else if (event?.type === 'tool/code-dispatch') {
      const call = calls.get(data?.subCallId)
      if (!call || call.name !== data.name) continue
      nodes.push({ kind: 'tool-result', call, callTime: call.time, content: data.content, isError: data.isError })
    }
  }
  return latestChart(nodes)
}

export function latestChart(nodes: readonly any[]): ChartReference | undefined {
  let latest: ChartReference | undefined
  const visit = (node: any) => {
    for (const child of node.subCalls ?? []) visit(child)
    if (node.kind !== 'tool-result' || node.isError) return
    if (!/^mcp__dsh[_-]kline__(?:analyze_kline(?:_rows)?|(?:create|update|delete)_(?:(?:horizontal|trend)_line|channel|rectangle))(?:_[a-f0-9]+)?$/.test(node.call?.name ?? '')) return

    const match = serialized.match(/chart_session(?:\\?"\s*:\s*\\?"|=)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})/)
    if (!match) return
    const order = Number(node.callTime ?? node.time ?? node.seq ?? 0)
    if (!latest || order >= latest.order) latest = { session: match[1], order }
  }
  for (const node of nodes) visit(node)
  return latest
}

  return `dsh-kline:conversation:${encodeURIComponent(conversationId)}`

 * Bridge the DSH FTShare settings credential into the MCP server's process.
 *

import { chmod, lstat, mkdir, mkdtemp, readdir, rename, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path'

/** Environment variable naming the bridge file for the Python MCP server. */
export const SETTINGS_CREDENTIAL_ENV = 'DSH_KLINE_SETTINGS_KEY_FILE'
/** Directory, relative to the runtime directory, owned by the host bridge. */
export const CREDENTIAL_DIRECTORY = 'credentials'
const CREDENTIAL_FILE_PATTERN = /^ftshare-(\d+)\.json$/u
const MAX_KEY_LENGTH = 512

/**
 * Structural view of the settings service this bridge depends on.
 *
 * Declared here instead of imported from the settings plugin so that a host
 * without that plugin needs no dependency, type, or build edge on it.
 */
export interface FtshareApiKeySettings {
  /** Current Key, `undefined` when nothing is configured. */
  resolve(): Promise<string | undefined>
  /** Credential invalidation notification; returns an unsubscribe function. */
  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void
}

/** Host service name published by the DSH FTShare settings plugin. */
export interface FtshareSettingsService {
  readonly apiKey: FtshareApiKeySettings
}

export interface FtshareSettingsBridgeOptions {
  settings: FtshareSettingsService
  /** Runtime directory shared with the launcher and the MCP server. */
  runtimeDirectory: string
  /** Owning DSH host process, matching the accompanying service locator. */
  hostPid?: number
  /** Optional diagnostic sink; the bridge stays silent without one. */
  warn?: (message: string) => void
}

export interface FtshareSettingsBridge {
  /** Stop following the credential and remove the published file. */
  dispose(): Promise<void>
}

/**
 * Path of the credential file published by the DSH host.
 *
 * The launcher mirrors this rule in `scripts/run-dsh-kline.mjs`; keeping the
 * owner pid in the name means a file left behind by an earlier host can never
 * be read by a later one.
 */
export function settingsCredentialFile(runtimeDirectory: string, hostPid: number): string {
  return join(runtimeDirectory, CREDENTIAL_DIRECTORY, `ftshare-${hostPid}.json`)
}

/**
 * Follow the settings credential until the returned bridge is disposed.
 *
 * The current Key is published immediately and re-published on every
 * invalidation; clearing the Key removes the file.  Failures are reported to
 * `warn` and otherwise ignored: a credential convenience must never take the
 * chart down.
 */
export function startFtshareSettingsBridge(options: FtshareSettingsBridgeOptions): FtshareSettingsBridge {
  const hostPid = options.hostPid ?? process.pid
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(hostPid) || hostPid <= 0) throw new Error('invalid host process id')
  const file = settingsCredentialFile(options.runtimeDirectory, hostPid)
  const directory = dirname(file)
  let pending: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
  let disposed = false

  const sync = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const key = usableKey(await options.settings.apiKey.resolve())
    if (disposed) return
    if (key) await writeCredentialFile(file, key)
    else await withdrawCredentialFile(file)
  }
  const schedule = (): Promise<void> => {
    pending = pending.then(sync, sync).catch(async () => {
      // Failed resolution/rotation must not leave a previously published key
      // active. Never include provider exception text: it may contain a key.
      await withdrawCredentialFile(file).catch(() => {})
      try { options.warn?.('FTShare settings credential publication failed') } catch {}
    })
    return pending
  }

  const unsubscribe = options.settings.apiKey.subscribe(() => { void schedule() })
  void pruneCredentialDirectory(directory, hostPid).catch(() => {})
  void schedule()

  return {
    async dispose(): Promise<void> {
      disposed = true
      unsubscribe()
      await pending.catch(() => {})
      await withdrawCredentialFile(file).catch(() => {})
    },
  }
}

/** Reject anything the Python reader would discard, so both sides agree. */
function usableKey(value: unknown): string {
  const key = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : ''
  if (!key || key.length > MAX_KEY_LENGTH) return ''
  for (const character of key) {
    const code = character.codePointAt(0) ?? 0
    if (code < 32 || code === 127) return ''
  }
  return key
}

async function writeCredentialFile(file: string, key: string): Promise<void> {
  const directory = dirname(file)
  await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  const info = await lstat(directory)
  if (!info.isDirectory() || info.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('unsafe credential directory')
  await restrict(directory, 0o700)
  // Exclusive random directory prevents following a pre-created temporary
  // symlink and keeps concurrent publishers from sharing a staging file.
  const staging = await mkdtemp(join(directory, `.${basename(file)}.`))
  const temporary = join(staging, 'credential.json')
  try {
    await restrict(staging, 0o700)
    await writeFile(temporary, JSON.stringify({ version: 1, api_key: key }), { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' })
    await restrict(temporary, 0o600)
    await rename(temporary, file)
    await restrict(file, 0o600)
  } finally {
    await rm(staging, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {})
  }
}

/** Drop files owned by hosts that are gone; a stale Key must not linger. */
async function pruneCredentialDirectory(directory: string, keepPid: number): Promise<void> {
  const info = await lstat(directory)
  if (!info.isDirectory() || info.isSymbolicLink()) return
  for (const name of await readdir(directory)) {
    const match = CREDENTIAL_FILE_PATTERN.exec(name)
    if (!match) continue
    const pid = Number(match[1])
    if (pid === keepPid || !Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid <= 0 || isAlive(pid)) continue
    await rm(join(directory, name), { force: true })
  }
}

async function withdrawCredentialFile(file: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const info = await lstat(dirname(file))
    if (!info.isDirectory() || info.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('unsafe credential directory')
    await rm(file, { force: true })
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT') throw error
  }
}

function isAlive(pid: number): boolean {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0)
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    // A live process owned by someone else is still a live process.
    return (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'EPERM'
  }
}

async function restrict(path: string, mode: number): Promise<void> {
  // Windows has no POSIX mode bits; the Python reader only enforces them there
  // as well, so a platform that cannot apply them is not an error.
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') await chmod(path, mode)
}

    'Content-Length': String(body.length),

    values = dict(parameters or {})

    if any(key not in values or values[key] is None for key in spec.required):

    if function == "price_pattern_candidates":

            max_candidates=effective["max_candidates"],

            left_bars=effective["left_bars"], right_bars=effective["right_bars"],
